name: Other armed conflicts
value: Ethiopia: Tigray fighting; Badme clashes claimed
summary: Ethiopian forces reportedly retook Rama in Tigray on 7 Nov; unconfirmed Ethiopia–Eritrea clashes near Badme on 9 Nov
state: Federal forces and the Tigray Defence Forces clashed near Rama on 7 Nov, with ACLED reporting that federal forces retook it; Eritrean forces reportedly reinforced around Badme, where trackers reported clashes and Ethiopian drone strikes on 9 Nov that could not be verified (Critical Threats, 10 Nov). The army also reportedly retook Wurgessa in Amhara from Fano on 10 Nov. FEWS NET said on 10 Nov that renewed fighting and drought will push parts of Tigray, Amhara and Afar into Emergency food insecurity in 2027 (Addis Standard via AllAfrica). No capital is under attack and no interstate war is confirmed.
for_you: Residents of Tigray, Amhara and areas near the Eritrean border face displacement and disrupted aid. Travellers should follow FCDO advice, which warns against travel to much of northern Ethiopia.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration in Ethiopia (Tigray, Amhara); Ethiopia–Eritrea clashes unconfirmed, no interstate war
